Type

Lucius is an NPC located in the  Wilderness. They sell the  Shady Ring and its upgrades to the player.

Contents

  • 1 Shop
  • 2 Interface
  • 3 Dialogue
  • 4 Trivia
  • 5 References
  • 6 History
  • 7 Navigation

Shop

[edit | edit source]

Lucius will sell a line of Accessories to the player after they have purchased certain amounts of items from the Dark Auction. These Accessories give discounts at most NPC shops. Each Accessory can only be purchased once per player profile.

Item Requirement Cost
 Shady Ring 1 item purchased from Dark Auction.
  • 500,000 Coins
 Crooked Artifact 3 items purchased from Dark Auction.
  • 2,000,000 Coins
  •   Shady Ring
 Seal of the Family 7 items purchased from Dark Auction.
  • 10,000,000 Coins
  •   Crooked Artifact

Interface

[edit | edit source]
Lucius

Dialogue

[edit | edit source]
Condition Dialogue
Before purchasing an item from Dark Auction
[NPC] Lucius: Psst! Listen here!
[NPC] Lucius: Not too loud!
[NPC] Lucius: My cousin Sirius leads an... organization.
[NPC] Lucius: It's a... business, auctioning sweet items.
[NPC] Lucius: He regularly runs events at a nearby house, but only under the cover of night.
[NPC] Lucius: Buy a few items from Sirius and come back!
Purchasing less than 3 items from the Dark Auction
[NPC] Lucius: You've purchased <number> items from the Dark Auction.
[NPC] Lucius: Come back when you've purchased 3. I'll have something for you then.
Purchasing less than 7 items from the Dark Auction
[NPC] Lucius: You've purchased <number> items from the Dark Auction.
[NPC] Lucius: Come back when you've purchased 7. I'll have something for you then.
After purchasing 7
items from Dark Auction
[NPC] Lucius: You've purchased 7 items from the Dark Auction.
[NPC] Lucius: You're basically family at this point.

Trivia

[edit | edit source]
  • Purchasing the Seal of the Family from Lucius awards the player with the "Lifelong Contract" Achievement.
  • The name Lucius is derived from the Latin lūx[1], which means light, and is a cognate both with Lucifer ("light-bringer" in Latin)[2] and the name Lucas (It is derived from the Latin verb "lucere", meaning "to shine".)[3].
  • Lucius' name is a reference to the Harry Potter books. In Harry Potter, Lucius Malfoy is Sirius Black's cousin-in-law.
    • The Latin name Sirius has roots in Ancient Greek, who's theorised meanings include "sparkling" "flickering" or "scorching", drawing another parallel between the two NPCs.[4]
  • Hypixel started counting the number of items each player purchases from the Dark Auction on Dec 4th, 2019. All items purchased prior to that date do not count as bought items.
